verdict.rationale: Zulip's API/bot framework lets users write custom bots that react to messages and can be deployed persistently via the Zulip Botserver to 'stay up' in production, and 130+ native integrations plus Zapier/IFTTT extend this to broader automation workflows. However, this is a general-purpose bot/integration framework rather than an AI-native autonomous-agent automation system, with no evidence of scheduled/triggered agentic workflows, LLM-specific automation, or independent hands-on validation of bots running unattended long-term. Missing for 10: AI-agent-specific automation tooling, scheduling/trigger primitives beyond message-reaction, and independent corroboration of autonomous background operation.
